headline: Touchstone Partners acts on AllHome ₹200 crore Series B fundraise
sum: All Home Bharat Platform Private Limited has raised ₹200 crore from a Series B fundraise led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with participation from certain family offices. Touchstone Partners advised AllHome on this fundraise.
detail: All Home Bharat Platform Private Limited has raised ₹200 crore from a Series B fundraise led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with participation from certain family offices. Touchstone Partners advised AllHome on this fundraise. The transaction team consisted of Pranay Bagdi (Partner), Associates Rajvee Bavishi and Aniket Singh. The Firm had also advised AllHome in their Series A fundraise.
